Unibox & AI replies

Every LinkedIn reply, from every account, in one inbox

The Unibox collects replies from all your LinkedIn sender accounts, puts unread conversations first, and drafts three replies on request. You decide what gets sent. Personal chats stay private.

Book a demoSee the AI co-pilot
The Unibox

What is the Connectora Unibox?

The Unibox is Connectora's single inbox for every LinkedIn account connected as a sender. It shows each outreach conversation with the account it came from, lifts unread replies to the top, and lets you reply with text, files or voice notes. Replies automatically stop that lead's follow-up sequence.

  • Filter by sending account with one click on its avatar.
  • Search by name, last message or headline.
  • Filter by date range, campaign, or replies only. Filters combine.
  • Unread first. New replies rise to the top; an opened thread keeps its place until you move on.
  • Deep links. "View in Unibox" on any campaign lead opens the exact conversation, and CRM links can point straight to a thread.

Conversations come from your campaigns.

AI co-pilot

How does the AI reply co-pilot work?

Click Draft with AI in any conversation and choose a goal: natural reply, follow-up, handle an objection, or propose a meeting. Add optional guidance. The co-pilot reads the last ten messages, the lead's LinkedIn profile and your company context, then writes three drafts. You pick one, edit it, and click Send yourself.

ModeWhat the drafts aim to do
Natural replyAnswer the last message in a normal, human way
Follow-upRe-open a quiet thread with one low-friction question, no pitch
Handle objectionAddress the concern honestly, using only facts from your company context
Propose a meetingMove to a concrete next step with one clear call to action
  • Three lengths to choose from: short, medium and detailed.
  • On demand only. Drafts are generated when you click, for the conversation you are in. Nothing runs in bulk.
  • Human in the loop by design. The co-pilot cannot send messages. Only a person clicking Send can.
Hold & Resume

What is Hold & Resume?

Hold & Resume protects your warmest leads. If someone replies to your connection note before you have sent them a message, Connectora pauses their sequence and flags the conversation for review instead of closing them out. You reply personally, then click Resume to put them back into the campaign when they accept.

Why it matters: a person who reads your note and answers it is often your most interested prospect. Without a hold, an automated sequence could either talk over them or drop them entirely. With Hold & Resume:

  1. The reply arrives and the lead is marked replied and held.
  2. The Unibox shows a Resume banner on that conversation.
  3. You answer. When you are ready, click Resume and the lead continues with the sequence.

Connectora also re-checks every conversation right before a follow-up goes out. If the lead has replied, the follow-up is not sent.

How this fits the wider safety approach: LinkedIn account safety.

Privacy

Will other people see my personal LinkedIn messages?

No. The Unibox only stores and shows conversations with people Connectora itself contacted through your campaigns, or conversations you deliberately import. Personal LinkedIn chats on a connected account, with friends, colleagues or anyone else, are never pulled into Connectora at any point.

This matters most when a team connects several real people's LinkedIn accounts. Each person's private inbox stays private; only the outreach threads are shared.

Connected accountPrivate by design
Outreach conversationsIn the Unibox
Chats you deliberately importIn the Unibox
Personal chatsNever pulled in
Replying

What can I send from the Unibox?

From the Unibox you can send text, up to five file attachments of 15 MB each, voice notes that LinkedIn plays as a native voice message, and emoji. Press Ctrl or Cmd plus Enter to send. A footer always shows which LinkedIn account the reply will go from.

  • Received files open securely inside Connectora.
  • Day separators (Today, Yesterday, dates) make long threads easy to scan.
  • Sync pulls in anything new; opening a thread refreshes that conversation.
Import Chat

Can I import existing LinkedIn conversations?

Yes. Import Chat brings an existing LinkedIn conversation into the Unibox, for example when you move from another tool. Choose the account that owns the chat, paste the lead's profile URL, preview up to the last 12 messages, then import. If no chat exists yet with a first-degree connection, you can write the first message there.

  • Connection-aware. Before you type, Connectora tells you whether you can message the person: first-degree or Open Profile (yes), invitation pending (wait), or second or third degree (connect first).
  • Kept separate from campaigns. Imported conversations never receive automated steps and never count in campaign statistics or dashboard totals.
  • No duplicates. Messages keep their original identity, so later syncs never show them twice.
CRM

How do LinkedIn replies get into my CRM?

Connectora sends a signed webhook for every inbound LinkedIn reply to a URL you set, such as a Zapier or Make webhook or your CRM's own endpoint. The payload includes the conversation history and a link to the thread in the Unibox, so your sales team can follow up where they already work.

  • Exactly one delivery per message, with automatic retries for temporary failures.
  • Verifiable signature so your system can confirm the request came from Connectora.
